content_text_body:
When you feel connected to the other people on your team, you are more likely to feel like you belong. The goal is to develop stronger relationships that are a balance between personal and professional.
### Develop a personal connection
Seek opportunities to understand each team member. Get to know their likes, values, and goals. Share your own interests. 

### Have fun
Participate in or create opportunities to have fun together. Organize happy hours or other casual events that let your team enjoy and get to know each other better. Include members who are working remotely by hosting a virtual happy hour.
### Be authentic
Your team cannot connect with you if they do not know you. Speak openly and honestly. Share your ideas, concerns and plans. Be yourself.
